Pandora Raven • Master Character Sheet

The Shadow Form

Dark Pandora

"The darkness she was taught to be."

Dark Abilities

01. Purple Gaze: Mind-breaking stare that unravels will.
02. Dark Mass: Gravitational pull that crushes and corrupts.
03. Mist of Ruination: Corruptive mist that decays and blinds.
04. String Theory: Threads of chaos that bind, distort, and sever.
05. Femme Fatale: Allure as a weapon. Love turned to ruin.
06. Kiss of Death: A touch that steals life and silences the soul.

Pandora Raven

Light Twin • Raised in Darkness

Basic Information

  • Age: 22-24 (Appears)
  • Ethnicity: Croatian Descent
  • Height: 170 cm (5'7")
  • Build: Tall, Slender, Graceful
  • Eyes (Dark): Purple
  • Eyes (Light): Grey-Green
  • Skin: Porcelain Pale

Saga Brief

Born the twin who carried light—warmth, the sun's half. Taken during wartime and raised as a weapon. Given a name that meant catastrophe. Taught that she was the darkness, and believed it. Over time, she transitions from a corrupted instrument to a self-aware force, eventually reclaiming her light.

The Purified Form

Light Pandora

"The light she was born to be."

Light Abilities

01. Searing Gaze: Blazing light that purifies and burns evil.
02. Radiance Burst: Explosive wave of holy radiance.
03. Light Tether: Tether of light that binds and protects.
04. Purifying Touch: Heals, cleanses, and removes corruption.
05. Illuminate: Reveals truth, hidden paths, and illusions.
06. Soul Read: Reads intentions and sees beyond the veil.

Aesthetic & Motifs

Sacred Cathedrals Sunlight Radiance Holy Magic

Cosmic Timeline & Chronicles

The historical record of Pandora Raven mapped across the levels and folds of the Wacky Cosmos ecosystem.

Level 1 Fold 1 (1_1)

The Origin & The Blessing

300,000 Years Ago

The union of Time and Fate (blessed by Ra) results in the birth of Pandora Raven and Elara Dawn. Ra is exiled to Level 15 Fold 15 for blessing this convergence. The twins are split across dimensions.

Level 12 Fold 15 (12_15)

The Indie Rock & Pop Legends

Modern Era

The Sparks ignite, playing raw underground ska-punk. Maya inherits the legacy and builds stadium pop. That Guy rants and breaks cages. A vibrant age of musical and emotional expression.

Level 15 Fold 15 (15_15)

The Scavenger End Game

Wasteland Era

Timo and Prima scavenging scrap tech. Ra joins their crew. Solara will eventually travel to this fold to reunite all levels and folds in the cosmos.
